loginCheck: window.__CONN.loggedIn() — the composer is present only when signed in. A login wall => return error login_required.

deep_research.desc: Long, multi-source researched report. UI-ONLY — no API equivalent. This is the headline reason to own a ChatGPT tab.
deep_research.activate: Open the composer '+' / tools menu and select 'Deep research' before sending. It usually asks 1-2 scoping questions; if command.unattended, reply 'proceed with reasonable assumptions'.

canvas.desc: Canvas doc/code editor for iterative long-form artifacts.
canvas.activate: Tools menu -> Canvas, or ask 'open this in canvas'.

code_files.desc: Advanced Data Analysis emits downloadable files (csv/xlsx/zip/png).
code_files.activate: Ask it to produce the file and give a download link.

promptSyntax.notes: No system prompt over the UI — put role/framing inline at the top of the message. One task per turn keeps scraping clean. For deep_research lead with the question, then scope, then the deliverable shape.

settle.doneSignal: [data-testid="send-button"] present AND copy/regenerate controls on the last turn

downloads: Files land in the OS Downloads dir; connector returns the name, Code resolves the newest match.
warnings: Selectors and the Deep Research menu path drift — verify against the live DOM and re-anchor here when they break.
verified_2026_06_25: Live-tested OK. #prompt-textarea, send-button, and composer-plus-btn (aria 'Add files and more') all confirmed. Insert text with document.execCommand('insertText') — the CDP 'type' action froze the renderer (~30s timeout). Enable Deep Research AFTER inserting text: selectAll+insertText clears the active tool. The Deep Research plan / 'Researching…' turn is NOT tagged data-message-author-role=assistant while running, so isSettled needs a long timeout plus a get_page_text/plan-card fallback.
